Project Announcement & Technical Preview (v0.4.1) • x64 & ARM64

RaggieSoft Installer Studio — Install Without Limits.

An original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 Windows packaging suite for x64 and ARM64. Design projects visually with modern AeroWizards, Destination Computer folder trees, Dual C++ & MSI.DLL Dialog Designers, and a built-in native C++ F1 Help Viewer—or let coding agents author comment-preserving .rsip manifests from scratch into real .msi, .msm, .mst, .msp, and WCAG 2.2 AA Setup.exe installers.

Why I'm Building This • Open Engineering Roadmap

What RaggieSoft Installer Studio Aims to Solve

Every Windows installer ultimately marshals calls down into the exact same msi.dll and cabinet.dll libraries Microsoft already ships inside C:\Windows\System32 on every copy of Windows. Yet developers are routinely forced to choose between multi-gigabyte legacy toolchains, steep XML boilerplate, unlabeled non-accessible wizard forms, or opaque project files that fight Git version control and AI coding agents.

RaggieSoft Installer Studio is an active, open-source MIT engineering effort to build an original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 packaging suite from the ground up—combining visual convenience with clean plain-text .rsip manifests, first-class AI specifications, and 100% WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.

Shipping Today in Technical Preview (v0.4.1)

  • 100% Dark-Mode-Complete Win32 UI + Live OS Theme Hot-Swapping: Custom-subclassed push buttons, checkboxes, SysListView32 headers, and RichEdit panels that flip live on WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet) without restarting
  • 10-View Win32 C++20 IDE (InstallerStudio.exe) with 5 native AeroWizards—with Community Edition maintaining 100% feature parity with Premier
  • Zero-Dependency Native C++20 Help System (RaggieSoftHelp.exe): Pluggable module.rshm.json offline documentation viewer with Contents, Index, Search, and instant Named Pipe F1 navigation
  • Authentic MSI SelectionTree & Pre-MSI Runtime Engine: 32-bit ARGB split-icon feature tree in Setup.exe, unlimited [Prerequisite.*] runtimes with custom reboot-code latching, and 64-bit .MSM Merge Module merging
  • Windows LZMS Solid Compression + msiprism.exe 64-bit Dark Mode SQL inspector + instbuild.exe --emit-ai-spec & --emit-vpat

Next Milestones on the Workbench (Phases B–G)

  • Single-Download Universal Web & Offline Installers + .NET 11 Presets: Replace separate x64 / ARM64 links with one CPU-aware Web Setup.exe (fetching only the right architecture via .rswpak On-Demand Feature Packs) plus one All-in-One Offline Setup.exe, alongside curated .NET 11 + .NET 10 LTS detection and optional Engine = native
  • 8 Wizard Styles (Wizard95, Wizard97, AeroWizard, FluentMica, OneClickSplash, PassiveToast, FullScreenBlue & Autorun16x9) + automatic SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST contrast-theme override
  • WCAG-Guarded Publisher Branding & From-Scratch Dual Dialog Builders: Full Light/Dark brand colors with live WCAG 2.2 AA contrast enforcement, custom C++ & raw 370×270 MSI.DLL dialogs, RsDialog (Rs*()) scripting, and Authenticode / Azure Artifact Signing UX
  • Setup Capture (.wsb Sandbox), VB6 .vbp Reg-Free COM Import & White-Label RsUpdate.exe: Snapshot-diff repackager, Visual Studio .slnx / VB6 .vbp importers, guided .MSP servicing, native .MSIXBUNDLE, and SPDX/CycloneDX --emit-sbom

Core Engineering Design Principles

The "Zero-Bloat" Architecture Matrix

Technical Architecture Goals for RaggieSoft Installer Studio
Design Pillar RaggieSoft Installer Studio Why It Matters
Toolchain Footprint Compact static /MT binaries (InstallerStudio.exe, instbuild.exe, SetupWizard.exe, msiprism.exe & RaggieSoftHelp.exe) Instant cold startup on local developer workstations and CI runners without multi-gigabyte framework installs.
Runtime Dependencies Zero third-party DLLs (System32\msi.dll, cabinet.dll, gdiplus.dll & Msftedit.dll only) Even the offline F1 Help Viewer runs natively in C++20 on stock Windows 11 (x64 & ARM64) with zero .NET or WebView2 requirements.
Windows Installer Rules ICE18, ICE38, ICE64 & ICE80 Enforced Validates Single-Directory Component rules, HKCU user-profile KeyPaths, CreateFolder, and 64-bit component attributes before msi.dll runs.
White-Label & Parity Community == Premier + 100% Author-Owned VERSIONINFO Community Edition enjoys full Premier feature parity, and compiled Setup.exe / .msi files carry your publisher identity with zero watermarks.
AI Agent Native --emit-ai-spec + --diagnostics=json Coding agents read deterministic /llms-full.txt and SKILL.md specs to write, lint, and compile installers from scratch.
Five Native Binaries in One Cohesive Toolkit

Suite Spotlight: IDE, CLI Compiler, Setup Wizard, MSI Prism & Help Viewer

InstallerStudio.exe — 10-View C++20 Visual IDE

Features 5 guided Win32 AeroWizards, a hierarchical Destination Computer folder tree, Setup Design (Features → Components → KeyPaths), Pre-MSI Runtimes & .MSM modules, Dual Dialog Designers, and a 100% comment-preserving .rsip AST!

Explore .rsip v0.4 Schema

instbuild.exe — Headless CI & AI Spec Compiler

Sub-millisecond --validate --diagnostics=json linting, automated --emit-vpat WCAG 2.2 AA conformance reports, and built-in --emit-ai-spec generation (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, SKILL.md) emitted directly from the C++20 constexpr grammar.

View Complete /llms-full.txt

msiprism.exe & RaggieSoftHelp.exe

Inspect relational SQL tables across .msi, .msm, and .msp databases in 64-bit Dark Mode with MSI Prism, and browse searchable offline HTML5 documentation in under 5ms via Named Pipe F1 IPC inside RaggieSoft Help Viewer.
